text:
Which statement about the extraction of iron from hematite is correct?
A
Air is blown into the blast furnace to oxidise the molten iron.
B
Carbon dioxide is reduced by coke to carbon monoxide.
C
Hematite is oxidised by carbon to molten iron.
D
The slag produced is denser than molten iron.

options.label: A
options.text: Air is blown into the blast furnace to oxidise the molten iron.

options.label: B
options.text: Carbon dioxide is reduced by coke to carbon monoxide.

options.label: C
options.text: Hematite is oxidised by carbon to molten iron.

options.label: D
options.text: The slag produced is denser than molten iron.
